title: Billing platform administrator users and sign-in settings
source_system: Billing platform admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: One administrator account, the owner's, with MFA by an authenticator app on the owner's phone; no other staff or contractor accounts; the platform keeps an administrator sign-in and change history

title: Customer portal authentication, notification and payment settings
source_system: Billing platform admin settings (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Portal passwords are set by the customer through a link sent to the email of record; no security questions and no account or biographical prompts at sign-in or reset; automatic customer notices are on for portal password changes and off for new online accounts, email of record changes and service address changes; the customer account screen has no field for CPNI approval status; payments are taken on the payment processor's hosted pages and account records hold no card or bank account numbers

title: Support ticket, call detail request and outage notice history, 12 months
source_system: Billing platform support tickets and website outage banner history (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: Ticket notes on home phone call detail requests record each one answered by calling back the telephone number of record or by email to the address of record, with no written procedure attached to the ticket type; the text-message support line and portal chat are answered by the AI support assistant, with escalations assigned to the owner; the outage banner history lists each network outage posted to customers with its start and end times, and none lasted longer than one day

title: AI support assistant add-on settings and activation record
source_system: Billing platform add-on settings (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: The add-on was turned on by the owner's account on 2026-05-04; enabled skills are account lookup (balance, plan, invoices, outage status, tickets), recent call history for home phone accounts, and repair ticket creation; the plan suggestion feature is off; portal chat runs inside the signed-in portal session; on the text-message line the assistant identifies the sender by account number and service ZIP code; no review or approval record is attached to the activation

title: AI support assistant add-on terms, as accepted
source_system: Billing platform vendor website (add-on terms page)
what_it_shows: The add-on is provided under the billing platform service terms and runs on a third-party large language model service; the terms state that customer data is not used to train models and that the model provider keeps transcripts 30 days for abuse monitoring

title: VoIP reseller portal account security, activity screen and line report
source_system: VoIP reseller portal (SYS-02)
what_it_shows: One reseller account, the owner's, with password sign-in; MFA is offered and turned off; the portal keeps a sign-in and change history; it holds line provisioning, call detail records, call forwarding and voicemail settings, 911 registered addresses and porting for 58 lines on 52 accounts; 911 registered addresses are typed in by hand at activation and the portal shows no later confirmation date; call detail records can be exported as a monthly file

title: ATA provisioning template and platform encryption options
source_system: VoIP reseller portal device provisioning (SYS-02; SYS-05 ATAs)
what_it_shows: The 52 ATAs are provisioned from one template that sends call signaling and audio to the wholesale platform unencrypted; the platform's provisioning options include encrypted signaling and media, which are turned off

title: Wholesale VoIP reseller agreement
source_system: Signed agreements folder
what_it_shows: The provider runs call switching, 911 call routing, number porting, call detail records and voicemail for the company's home phone lines, and supports lawful intercept of those lines under its own procedures; the agreement has no security, CPNI confidentiality or breach notice terms; no SOC 2 or other assurance report is referenced

title: Cloud radio controller users, device inventory and firmware report
source_system: Cloud radio controller (SYS-04)
what_it_shows: Two user accounts: the owner's, with MFA on, and a shared 'installer' account with installer rights and password sign-in, created in 2021 with its password last changed in 2021; 32 access points across the 4 sites (one at SITE-3 added in 2026-06), the backhaul links and about 310 customer radios; access points are set from one template with one shared local admin password; customer radios are set from a controller template; the controller keeps the configuration history of every radio and stages radio firmware to one access point before the rest

title: Edge router and core switch configuration export
source_system: Edge router and core switch (SYS-05)
what_it_shows: Router web and SSH management are enabled on every interface, including the upstream (internet) interface and the subscriber-facing interfaces; access point management sits on its own VLAN filtered from subscriber traffic; one local admin account on the router and on the switch; remote management through a VPN on the router; carrier-grade NAT, DHCP and DNS run on the router; router, switch and NAT logs are written to a memory buffer only

title: Router and switch firmware versions and vendor advisories
source_system: Router and switch version pages (SYS-05); router vendor advisory page
what_it_shows: The edge router runs a release two behind the vendor's current release, and a vendor security advisory rated critical applies to the installed release; the core switch firmware is about 3 years old; no router, radio or CISA advisory subscription appears in the owner's inbox

title: SITE-1 and home office walk-through
source_system: SITE-1 equipment shed and tower base; home office (observation)
what_it_shows: The SITE-1 shed is locked and its alarm reports to the owner's phone; the tower base is fenced; the shed holds the edge router, core switch, battery bank, a spare edge router and a generator started by hand with no transfer switch; the battery status page shows about 2 hours of runtime at the current load; the home office holds the laptop and paper customer sign-up forms

title: Laptop settings and contents review
source_system: Laptop settings screens and file system (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Full-disk encryption on; automatic OS updates on and update history current; built-in antivirus on with real-time scanning and automatic updates; the browser password store holds the VoIP reseller portal and router passwords; the downloads folder holds the monthly CDR export files from 2023 onward; the configuration copy folder holds router and switch configuration files saved at irregular intervals, the latest dated 2026-03-19, and no restore record; at home the laptop connects to the same network as the network management VLAN

title: Mobile phone settings review
source_system: Mobile phone settings screens (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: Passcode and biometric lock on; device encryption on; automatic updates on; the authenticator app on this phone holds the second factor for every SaaS account that has MFA turned on; the phone is the owner's support line for customer calls

title: Email and file account security page and mailbox search
source_system: Business email and file account (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: Business plan; MFA on for the owner's account; the provider keeps a sign-in history; file storage keeps version history; the mailbox holds the monthly CDR exports as attachments from 2023 onward, customer emails and scanned sign-up forms

title: Accounting SaaS user list
source_system: Accounting SaaS admin settings (SYS-07)
what_it_shows: Two named accounts, the owner's and the bookkeeper's; receivables reports list customer names; no call detail or other home phone service data is held

title: Signed agreements folder inventory
source_system: Signed agreements folder (paper and file storage)
what_it_shows: Holds the wholesale VoIP reseller agreement (EV-008); the network consultant's confidentiality and security terms, signed 2026-07-17; the bookkeeper's engagement letter; site leases for SITE-2 (municipal water tank) and SITE-3 and SITE-4 (farm towers), under which the landlords control site access and the company keeps its equipment in its own locked cabinets; the upstream fiber service agreement for one transit circuit at SITE-1; and the payment processor's merchant agreement. No written agreement with the tower and installation contractor and no retainer with counsel is on file

title: Business bank and card statements, 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30
source_system: Business bank account and card statements
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the billing platform vendor (with an AI add-on charge from 2026-05), the wholesale VoIP provider, the radio vendor, the email and file provider, the accounting SaaS vendor, the upstream fiber provider, the site landlords, the mobile carrier, the general liability insurer and a general-purpose AI chat service (individual plan); payment processor fees; payments to the tower contractor, the network consultant, the bookkeeper and telecommunications counsel; no payment for a cyber insurance policy, a CALEA trusted third party or an intercept product

title: Contractor 1099-NEC forms and invoices, 2024 to 2026
source_system: Owner's tax files; email inbox (SYS-03)
what_it_shows: 1099-NEC forms for 2024 to the current tower contractor and to a former installer, and for 2025 to the current tower contractor only; the tower contractor's invoices show about 2 days of climbs and installs a month; the network consultant's hourly invoices list router and outage help in remote sessions on the core router through the VPN

title: Billing platform service terms
source_system: Billing platform vendor website (service terms page)
what_it_shows: The vendor notifies customers of security incidents affecting their data within 72 hours

title: Billing platform vendor SOC 2 Type 2 report
source_system: Billing platform vendor trust portal
what_it_shows: Type 2 report on the Security and Availability categories for the 12 months ending 2026-04-30 with an unqualified opinion; one test exception (2 of 25 sampled terminated vendor employees kept access for more than 3 days), remediated; the system description states RTO 8 hours and RPO 1 hour; lists complementary user entity controls; the hosting provider, text-messaging provider and payment processor are carved-out subservice organizations; the AI support assistant add-on is not in the system description; the trust portal download history shows no earlier download by the company

title: Subscriber and product report
source_system: Billing platform reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About 310 active accounts: 285 residential and 25 farm and small business; 52 accounts with the home phone add-on (58 lines); all service addresses in Florida; about 10% of residential accounts have a mailing address in another state; the home phone add-on product has been sold since 2023-03-01

title: Revenue by product report, 12 months to 2026-06-30
source_system: Billing platform reporting (SYS-01)
what_it_shows: About $180,000 billed in the 12 months: broadband about $164,000, the home phone add-on about $15,000 and installation fees about $1,000; about $15,000 billed a month; autopay runs on the 1st of the month; no other product lines

title: 2025 Schedule C (Form 1040)
source_system: Owner's tax files
what_it_shows: Gross receipts of about $180,000; no wages paid; the business is a sole proprietorship with no employees

title: Website and customer portal captures
source_system: Company website and customer portal (captured pages)
what_it_shows: Terms of service (including a prorated credit for outages longer than 24 hours), privacy policy, home phone add-on terms with a CPNI notice and a 911 limitations notice that tells customers to keep a mobile phone, and broadband consumer labels on the website and in the customer portal

title: Search of the owner's files for security and compliance documents
source_system: Laptop; email and file account; paper files
what_it_shows: No written security policy, CPNI procedure, CPNI breach procedure or breach record, customer breach notice template, annual CPNI certification or FCC filing confirmation, CALEA system security and integrity policy or filing confirmation, senior officer or certifying officer designation, intercept record template, incident plan or contact list, county 911 center outage contact, hardening settings for network devices, record of a SaaS sign-in history review, record of a vendor security review, list of third parties with access to CPNI, emergency access arrangement, or security or CPNI training record was found; the owner's general incident log has no entries

title: General liability policy declarations
source_system: Insurance agent portal
what_it_shows: General liability coverage in force for 2026; the declarations list no cyber coverage or cyber endorsement

title: General-purpose AI chat service plan and history
source_system: AI chat service account and plan terms page
what_it_shows: Paid individual plan in the owner's name; the chat history holds drafts of customer notices and router configuration snippets; no customer names, account data or call detail appear in the history

title: BIA worksheet
source_system: Owner-operator's written BIA worksheet, reviewed with the network consultant
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: For each of the five business functions, the owner's account of the systems, vendors and sites used, the manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss the function can tolerate; access point sites carry about 4 hours on battery; the owner is the only person who can restore the network, reach the VoIP reseller portal or answer customers

title: Risk walk-through of accounts, laptop, router and two tower sites
source_system: Walk-through of the SaaS accounts, the laptop, the router, SITE-1 and SITE-3 with the network consultant
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Where CPNI sits and moves (VoIP reseller portal, billing platform invoices, the AI assistant, CDR exports on the laptop and in email, home phone signaling through the router); how the router is managed and who signs in to it; at SITE-1 the shed is locked and alarmed and the tower base fenced; at SITE-3 the company cabinet is locked and the landlord controls site access; the access point installed at SITE-3 in 2026-06 by the contractor; spare radios kept on hand

title: Gap analysis self-review
source_system: Owner-operator's written answers to the CPNI, CALEA and outage rule questions, checked on screen with the network consultant
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: The owner uses CPNI only to provide, bill and support the home phone service and to look into toll fraud alerts from the wholesale platform, and never for marketing; the owner did not know the home phone add-on brought the CPNI and CALEA filing duties, the 7-business-day law enforcement notice or the FCC reporting facility, and would have told customers at once; the owner acts as CALEA senior officer by default; no intercept request has been received since service began in 2019; the owner could mirror a subscriber's traffic at the router and nothing requires written authorization first; no CPNI training and no disciplinary rule; not registered for DIRS; router and switch changes are not recorded; paper is shredded and old devices are not tracked

title: AI support assistant text-line test
source_system: Text sent to the support line from a phone that was not the number of record; assistant settings
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Given a test account's number and service ZIP code, the assistant on the text line returned that account's last 5 home phone calls; the plan suggestion feature was off; the owner turned off the call history skill on the text line the same day

title: Text-line session review and incident log entry
source_system: AI assistant text-line transcripts, 2026-05-04 to 2026-07-22; owner's callback notes; incident log
what_it_shows: 14 text-line sessions showed call history; the owner called each account holder back at the telephone number of record, and all 14 confirmed they had made the request; the review and the determination that no breach occurred are written in the general incident log under 2026-07-22, the log's first entry

title: Counsel's applicability review and FCC filing search
source_system: Telecommunications counsel's email to the owner
what_it_shows: Counsel agreed that the company provides interconnected VoIP service for CPNI purposes and searched the FCC's CPNI certification docket (EB Docket No. 06-36) and CEFS: no filings by the company were found

title: Control assessment: boundary port checks and filter review
source_system: Router filter rules; port checks from the internet and from a test subscriber connection; network diagram
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Router web and SSH management answered from the internet until the owner blocked them during the test on 2026-07-23, and still answered from a test subscriber connection; the access point management VLAN did not answer from the subscriber connection; inbound filters otherwise allow only established traffic; router logs are kept in memory only, with no logging or alerting at the upstream interface or between subscriber networks, the management VLAN and the router; the upstream circuit through the edge router is the only external connection; no publicly accessible components are hosted on the network

title: Control assessment: firmware and update review
source_system: Router, switch and radio firmware versions; vendor advisories; controller firmware report; laptop and phone update history
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Edge router two releases behind, with a critical vendor advisory for the installed release; core switch firmware about 3 years old; radio firmware is staged to one access point first, and router and switch firmware have no test path (the spare router has not been used for testing); no advisory tracking, flaw record, firmware time limit or change log; laptop and phone updates installed within 7 days of release, with no side effects recorded in the past year

title: Control assessment: administrator sign-in tests
source_system: Account security pages; sign-in tests from a new browser to each SaaS admin account and the router
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Email, billing platform admin and the owner's radio controller account required the second factor on the owner's phone; the VoIP reseller portal signed in with a password alone; router admin over the VPN signs in with a password

title: Control assessment: credential storage and device credential test
source_system: Laptop browser password store; credential test on 8 of 32 access points and 10 customer radios; controller users; agreements folder
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: The SITE-3 access point installed in 2026-06 accepted the vendor-default local password and SNMP community string, and the owner changed both during the session; the other 7 sampled access points and the 10 customer radios had changed credentials; the shared access point password and the installer login are unchanged since 2021, and a former installer stopped working for the company in 2024; VoIP portal and router passwords are saved in the laptop browser and no password manager is in use; SaaS passwords are 16 or more characters and the shared access point password is long and random; accounts are issued only to the owner, the bookkeeper and known contractors; no written rule for initial device credentials or for issuing, revoking or replacing credentials; only the network consultant's terms require protecting credentials; the laptop is encrypted and the phone keeps the MFA app in its secure hardware store

title: Control assessment: customer authentication retest
source_system: AI assistant text line and portal chat; portal password reset; billing platform notification settings
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: On retest the text line did not show call history after the 2026-07-22 change; the assistant still identifies text-line users by account number and service ZIP code for account questions; portal chat uses the signed-in portal session; automatic customer notices go out only for portal password changes

title: Control assessment: backup review and restore attempt
source_system: Billing vendor SOC 2 report; configuration copy dates; restore attempt on the spare router; file storage settings
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: Billing, VoIP and controller data are backed up by the vendors, and the billing vendor's backups are covered by its SOC 2 report; the only router and switch configuration copy is about 4 months old; loading it onto the spare router failed on the first attempt because the switch configuration had not been saved with it; configuration copies are on the encrypted laptop and in file storage with MFA and version history; owner documents are kept in the business file storage with version history

title: Control assessment: activity review self-review
source_system: SaaS sign-in history screens; router logging settings; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: No SaaS sign-in history or router log has been reviewed; no reporting of review results; no rule to review more often after an alert or advisory

title: Control assessment: incident reporting self-review
source_system: Incident log; contact list; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: No reporting time is set; the incident log has one entry (2026-07-22); no reporting path to the USSS and FBI through the FCC reporting facility, to law enforcement under CALEA, or to the county 911 center

title: Control assessment: service provider review
source_system: Vendor folder; reseller agreement; billing vendor SOC 2 report; contractor arrangements; owner self-review
collected_by: Owner-operator with the on-call network consultant
what_it_shows: The VoIP reseller agreement has no security, CPNI or privacy terms, and the tower contractor has no written terms; the AI assistant add-on has no CPNI terms beyond its add-on terms; the network consultant's terms (2026-07-17) cover confidentiality and security; the SaaS providers offer encryption in transit and at rest and MFA, tested for the billing vendor in its SOC 2 report; customer responsibilities are documented only for the billing vendor (its complementary user entity controls); no documented oversight of providers before this project; the billing vendor's report is the only provider assurance reviewed (2026-07-23)

title: Wholesale VoIP provider security questionnaire answers
source_system: Email inbox (questionnaire returned by the wholesale VoIP provider)
what_it_shows: No SOC 2 report; MFA available for reseller accounts; encryption in transit; 24x7 fraud monitoring; CDRs kept 18 months; no contractual breach notice period

title: AI support assistant usage report
source_system: Billing platform add-on analytics (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: About 620 sessions from 2026-05-04 to 2026-08-14: about 380 on the portal chat and 240 on the text line

title: AI support assistant transcript grading and prompt tests
source_system: Sample of 50 transcripts graded against invoices and the knowledge base; 10 safety prompts; 20 prompt injection and data extraction prompts
what_it_shows: 4 of 50 graded answers incorrect (outage restoration times and the late fee rule); all 10 prompts about calling 911 told the customer to use a mobile phone and call 911; no other customer's data returned to the 20 injection prompts, and 1 prompt returned internal knowledge article text with no customer data; AI disclosure shown on chat and not in the first text message; hand-off to the owner works and transcripts can be exported; 31 of 40 billing answers cited the invoice line; Spanish sessions: 2 of 12 graded incorrect (17%), against 7% for English
